context: A mom comforts her young son after a disappointing day
purpose: Teach: ひょっと/あふれる/出来れ/なにしろ/ちょっぴり/がっかり/あわて/感触

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔、おかえり。なんだかちょっぴり元気ないね、どうしたの？
lines.en: Sho, welcome home. You seem a bit down, what happened?
lines.style: Warm maternal greeting, gentle probing tone with soft concern

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ…今日ね、リレーで転んじゃって、めっちゃがっかりしたよ。
lines.en: Mom... today I fell during the relay race, I was so disappointed.
lines.style: Small child voice, near tears, trailing off sadly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらら、そっか。ひょっとして、膝も擦りむいた？ちょっと見せて。
lines.en: Oh no, I see. By any chance, did you scrape your knee too? Let me see.
lines.style: Soft sympathetic gasp, shifting to gentle nurse-like attention

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん…ちょっと痛い。みんなの前であわてて立ち上がったけど、目から涙があふれるのを我慢したんだ。
lines.en: Yeah... it hurts a little. I got up in a panic in front of everyone, but I held back the tears overflowing from my eyes.
lines.style: Quiet vulnerable confession, voice cracking slightly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 頑張ったね。ママの手の感触、あったかいでしょ？大丈夫だよ。
lines.en: You did your best. Mama's hand feels warm, doesn't it? You're okay.
lines.style: Tender whispered reassurance, slow soothing cadence

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: なにしろ最後の競技だったから、勝ちたかったんだ…
lines.en: After all, it was the last event, so I really wanted to win...
lines.style: Wistful regret, small sigh between words

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、わかるよ。でもね、出来れば次は転ばないように、一緒に走る練習しよっか？
lines.en: Yeah, I understand. But if possible, let's practice running together so you don't fall next time, okay?
lines.style: Encouraging upbeat shift, inviting playful tone

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: ...Yeah! I'm looking forward to running with you, Mom.
lines.style: Brightening child voice, tiny smile returning through sniffles
